title: Introduction to Coordination
definition: Coordination helps the body detect change and respond appropriately.
description: A coordinated system links sensory input with safe action and regulation.
think_prompt: Why must the body respond quickly to a change in conditions?
quick_check: What is the purpose of coordination in living organisms?
answer: To keep conditions in the body stable and allow suitable responses.

title: Need for coordination
definition: Living organisms need coordination to respond appropriately to internal and external changes.
description: The body must detect and respond quickly to changing conditions.
think_prompt: How does an organism respond to a sudden change in its environment?
quick_check: Why is coordination necessary for survival?
answer: Because the body must respond in a suitable and timely way.

title: Stimulus and response
definition: Stimulus is a detectable change and response is the action taken by the body.
description: The body reacts when a stimulus is detected.
think_prompt: What is the difference between a stimulus and a response?
quick_check: State one example of a stimulus and its response.
answer: A change that triggers action and the corrective action taken by the body.
